# jumpcloud_system_group (Data Source)

Use this data source to read a JumpCloud system group by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up by name
data "jumpcloud_system_group" "production" {
  name = "Production Servers"
}

# Look up by ID
data "jumpcloud_system_group" "by_id" {
  id = "5f0c1234abcdef567890abcd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of the system group. Exactly one of id or name must be specified.
- `name` (String) The name of the system group. Exactly one of id or name must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the system group.
- `member_query` (String) JSON-encoded dynamic membership query.
- `membership_method` (String) Membership method: STATIC, DYNAMIC_REVIEW_REQUIRED, or DYNAMIC_AUTOMATED.
